description: Source file implementing the LoggingPreferences plugin class, managing keystroke mask logging preferences, including initialization, deinitialization, and event notification.

classes.name: LoggingPreferences
classes.description: A plugin class managing logging preferences, including methods to get/set keystroke mask enabled status and notifying changes.

methods.name: isKeystrokeMaskEnabled
methods.description: Retrieves whether keystroke masking is enabled.

methods.name: setKeystrokeMaskEnabled
methods.description: Sets the keystroke masking enabled or disabled.

methods.name: onKeystrokeMaskEnabledChange
methods.description: Notifies other components about the change in keystroke mask status.
